capture: real-time canvas, no offline frame synthesis

notes: wall clock timings, excluded from the observation digest
a debug build measures debug costs; compare like with like
median, p95, and frames-over-budget use the most recent bounded sample window (up to 1024 frames)

window.semantics: VM-safe-point sample counts, not exact function milliseconds or call counts. Native calls and GC are not asynchronously sampled. Short functions, inlining and safe-point placement can bias attribution; compare with sampling disabled.

render_cadence.note: CPU render completion intervals, not verified display presentation. Includes scheduling and simulation; paused renders must not be used as gameplay FPS.

host_window.note: Disjoint host CPU spans. WASM tick includes runtime and publication. GPU timing is separate. Distributions cover retained samples only.

profile.note: renderer counters may use a different rolling window; bridge_ms includes WASM tick, not pure bridge cost
